objective: Protect expensive trail systems with replaceable sacrificial armor while preserving clearance, serviceability, and a controlled impact load path.

facts: replaceable aluminum skid plates protect the vulnerable underside
replacement skid plates are sold as service parts
separate motor guard plate is offered
belt and hub guards are sold as replaceable parts for Endeavor models
gear-drive variants use enclosed metal gear housings

armor_layers.name: wear_shoe
requirements: retention hardware protected from direct terrain contact where practical

armor_layers.name: carrier_or_vendor_guard_structure
armor_layers.purpose: locate wear shoe and distribute impact into an intended load path
requirements: not attached to live-cell structure for initial qualification
does not use charge/data connectors as structure
does not block drivetrain or wheel service
does not create a forward-facing terrain hook

armor_layers.name: structural_mount
armor_layers.purpose: transfer residual load into qualified chassis structure
requirements: load path independent of adhesive alone
no unqualified safety-critical spacer or adapter

armor_layers.name: protected_component
armor_layers.purpose: drivetrain, motor, inert enclosure, or future electronics kept out of first-contact terrain path

geometry_principles: vulnerable drivetrain/enclosure hardware is not the lowest exposed hard point in its protected zone
armor must preserve full wheel, steering, brake, deck-flex, and service sweeps
leading and trailing armor geometry should slide over low-energy root/curb surrogates rather than present a hook
armor should not form a debris pocket or mud scoop that can pack into moving parts
wear surfaces should be replaceable without opening a traction enclosure where architecture allows
armor shall not be relied upon as primary battery retention

material_policy.rule: Do not freeze material or thickness from generic material properties alone. Select after contact geometry, load path, mass, wear, temperature, and topology are physically known.

prohibited_shortcuts: live battery used as first armor impact surrogate
skid attached only to battery shell without a qualified structural load path
guard whose removal requires disturbing unrelated brake retention
armor that becomes the lowest snag point without a root/curb surrogate test
unprotected fastener heads intentionally used as the wear surface
assuming a vendor skid proves X1 enclosure impact safety
